metadata.purpose: Separates FG2 from G2. FG2 does NOT imply G2.
metadata.theorem: FG2 does not imply G2 (3-element witness)
metadata.long_description: G2=F FG2=T FP=F. FG2 without G2, no syntactic FP. Concrete separation: FG2 does NOT imply G2. The preorder has 0<bot, T isolated. boxtimes orbit of T: T->bot->0->bot->0->... The nFG2(k) pattern oscillates: T,F,T,F,... showing FG2 does not imply nFG2(even).
